responsibility: Implements GCC’s arbitrary-precision finite-width integer engine used throughout tree, RTL, and range code. It provides the out-of-line core for wide_int construction from arrays/buffers, canonicalization, arithmetic, division, shifts, masking, insertion, modular inverse, overflow-aware operations, and other precision-sensitive utilities, backing the generic wide_int/offset_int/widest_int abstractions declared in wide-int.h.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line arithmetic, conversion, canonicalization, and selftest implementation for the wide-int framework declared in wide-int.h. Unlike wide-int-print.cc, this file is about integer semantics and operations, not formatting.
